arStrings.szText: While at least {c_number}4{/c} {c_important}Wisdom{/c} Charms equipped, your hit on Elite enemies creates an attackable Shade Totem for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. Any base damage you deal to it is replicated onto the same enemy. This effect has {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1]{/c} seconds cooldown.
